assertions.name: report-file-exists
assertions.description: 报告文件存在于 reports/ 目录下

assertions.name: correct-filename-format
assertions.description: 文件名符合 weekly-report-YYYY-MM-DD.md 格式

assertions.name: has-commit-section
assertions.description: 报告包含「提交记录」或「Commits」章节

assertions.name: has-todo-section
assertions.description: 报告包含 TODO 变更相关章节

assertions.name: references-branch-name
assertions.description: 报告中包含当前分支名 master

assertions.name: valid-markdown-structure
assertions.description: 文件是合法的 Markdown，包含 # 标题
